main.description: Accept or refuse a join request. Moderators only: the community account and the accounts its managing app names. Served by the managing app named in the community space's policy, at its #umbrae_app endpoint, with atproto service auth (iss the caller, aud the managing app, lxm this method); clients call through their PDS with atproto-proxy set to the policy's managingApp. Any managing app may serve it: a serving app, or a PDS that manages its own communities.

errors.name: CommunityNotFound
errors.description: Not a community this managing app manages.

errors.name: NotAllowed
errors.description: The caller lacks the role this needs.

errors.name: NotAdmitted
errors.description: The managing app doesn't admit this account.

errors.name: NoRequest
errors.description: That account hasn't asked to join.
